Placeholders: {BASE} the case's directory, {ROOT} the store root {BASE}/root, {REPO} a git repository {BASE}/repo with one commit, {TRAP} a directory holding files named 12345 and 345 (a bare 12* or 34? expands there). fixtures: copy method/scripts/fixtures/funnel-review/*.tsv into {ROOT}/docs/funnel-review/collected. files: extra files, written byte for byte. dirs: extra directories. cwd: the working directory (default {BASE}). modes: octal file modes set after the files are written. posix: the case needs POSIX file modes and a non-root user (an unreadable file).
